sentences.text:
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
21.03.2023 Item No.20 Suman Ct.42 Crr 4525 of 2022 Ramashray Verma and Ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal and another.

Mr. Rabi Sankar Chattopadhyay Ms. Trisha Rakshit Ms.
Rajashree Tah ..for the petitioners Matrimonial relations being the in-laws of the petitioner have approached this Court for quashing the criminal proceeding instituted against him being G.R. Case No. 2714 of 2022 arising out Hirapur Police Station Case No. 314 of 2022 dated August 19, 2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
I have perused the written complaint in the form of an application under Section 156(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
I have not found any specific complaint against the present petitioners.
All the complaints against the present petitioners are vague and omnibus.
Therefore, the instant revision is admitted.
The petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the private opposite party under registered speed post with A/D and file affidavit of service within three weeks from the date of this order.
The State of West Bengal be served through the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta.

In the meantime, further proceedings in connection with G.R. Case No. 2714 of 2022 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Paschim Bardhaman be stayed qua the present petitioners for a period of six weeks.
